advice_items.quote: Don't delegate too much, stay involved... people respect what you inspect.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay hands-on in your business and inspect what you delegate rather than over-delegating.
advice_items.summary_zh: 亲力亲为把控业务细节，别过度放权

advice_items.quote: I have a real estate business, I have a manufacturing business, I have a construction business... Never one.
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify across multiple businesses and industries instead of relying on only one.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多元化布局多个行业，不要只依赖单一业务

advice_items.quote: I know how to close a deal... I know what deal not to do, I know who not to talk to.
advice_items.summary_en: Master deal-making by knowing which deals to walk away from and who not to engage with.
advice_items.summary_zh: 精明筛选交易对象，懂得拒绝烂单与错误的人

advice_items.quote: Before you sit down make sure you know who you're debating against... don't take high-risk bets.
advice_items.summary_en: Know your counterparty before negotiating and avoid taking high-risk bets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 避免高风险盲目下注，先摸清对手再上谈判桌

guests.first_money_or_break: 并非出身富裕家庭，从事建筑行业35年（建造从费城到迈阿密的高楼），并拓展至房地产和制造业。
guests.zero_start_advice: 亲力亲为监督业务细节不要过度放权；多元化布局多个行业；学会辨别并拒绝烂交易，绝不盲目冒高风险。

advice_items.quote: Get a lot of help, raise a lot of money, yeah you got to trust your partners.
advice_items.summary_en: Raise significant capital, seek plenty of help, and trust your business partners when scaling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 积极融资寻求外援，并充分信任合作伙伴

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: If you make something people want you'll be okay... Product is everything. Without that, all the distribution in the world doesn't matter.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize creating a product people genuinely want; product matters even more than distribution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 产品为核心，打造人们真正需要的好产品

advice_items.quote: I started working in a shoe store when I was 16 so I've kind of been—that's sort of been my thing.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay deeply focused on one industry you know from the ground up over decades.
advice_items.summary_zh: 长期深耕单一行业，从基层做起保持专注

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Know What You Don't Know & Seek Help
advice_items.quote: Knowing what you don't know is such a gift and then you're able to get help, so that's sort of the secret.
advice_items.summary_en: Have the self-awareness to recognize what you do not know so you can bring in the right help.
advice_items.summary_zh: 正视自身知识盲区，懂得谦虚向他人求助

guests.first_money_or_break: 16岁起在鞋店打工积累经验，仅凭1100美元起家创立鞋履品牌并经营34年。
guests.zero_start_advice: 深耕自己熟悉的单一行业；把产品做到极致满足消费者真实需求；勇于融资和借力外援，正视自己不懂的领域并信任合作伙伴。

advice_items.quote: Buy two-story apartment and refurbish it and rent it and let it pay the mortgage and leverage it for credit.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy multi-family properties, renovate and rent them to cover the mortgage, and leverage equity for credit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 买入公寓翻新出租，用租金还贷并撬动信用杠杆

advice_items.quote: College was not where I got my information, it was from mentorship and being in a family business in the trenches with people that were doing it.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn directly from hands-on mentors in the trenches rather than relying solely on college.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从实战导师和一线磨砺中学习，而非只靠学校

advice_items.quote: You have to have a PhD in communication, you have to be able to articulate and be able to communicate effectively.
advice_items.summary_en: Develop top-tier communication skills by dealing with real people through difficult real-time situations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 练就卓越沟通表达力，在真实难题中磨炼应对

advice_items.quote: Just do your job and I promise you you're going to start to ratchet up the hierarchy your skill set and the people that are treating you bad will start to respect your work ethic.
advice_items.summary_en: Endure tough workplaces without ego, focus on doing the work, and let your work ethic earn respect and upward mobility.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在逆境中踏实做好本职工作，靠敬业赢得尊重

advice_items.quote: You can't react and be emotional. The best thing I can tell your viewers is don't be emotional, don't feed your emotions.
advice_items.summary_en: Never act reactively or let ego and emotions drive your decisions in business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做生意绝不情绪化，放下自我控制情绪反应

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾多次破产，在家族企业和一线实战中跟师学习，通过在新泽西做建筑废铁驳船拆解（年营收曾达1200万-1500万美元）及投资翻新房产积累财富。
guests.guest_name: NJ Scrap Iron, Electronics & Real Estate Owner
guests.role_or_title: Independent Contractor, Electronics Business Owner & Real Estate Investor
guests.zero_start_advice: 在一线向实战导师偷师；买入公寓翻新出租并用租金还贷加杠杆；在真实人际冲突中修得顶级沟通力；哪怕在不喜欢的环境里也克制情绪、专心提升硬实力。

advice_items.quote: The key is determination. You never give up. One day you fall on your face, you get back up and you do it all over again.
advice_items.summary_en: Determination separates top performers—never quit, get back up after every fall, and keep going.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持绝不放弃的决心，跌倒后再爬起来继续干

advice_items.quote: Everyone makes mistakes... it either makes you a better trader, you learn from your mistakes if you know it's your own fault.
advice_items.summary_en: Prepare emotionally for severe setbacks like margin calls, take accountability, and turn mistakes into improvement.
advice_items.summary_zh: 正视自身失误与爆仓教训，从中复盘成长

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Self-Direct Investments Rather Than Using Banks
advice_items.quote: I don't go for banks, I do it myself... the banks are good for people who want like 5%, 6%; I was making a lot more than that.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn to invest your own capital rather than leaving it with banks for modest 5%–6% returns.
advice_items.summary_zh: 自主管理投资追求更高回报，不轻信银行低息

advice_items.quote: Get in it now, 100 bucks here, 100 bucks there—you'd be surprised what's going to happen in 30, 40 years.
advice_items.summary_en: Start investing in the market early, even $100 at a time, and let it snowball over 30 to 40 years.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早从小额开始持续投资，让复利滚雪球

guests.first_money_or_break: 仅读过一年半大学，90年代末开始居家通过互联网交易期权，从零敲碎打逐步滚雪球（包括重仓亚马逊获利），并曾受邀参加纽交所早餐会。
guests.guest_name: Manhattan Options Trader & Real Estate Investor
guests.role_or_title: Options Trader & Real Estate/Finance Business Owner
guests.zero_start_advice: 趁年轻尽早入市，哪怕每次投100美元坚持三四十年也能产生惊人复利；学会自己投资而非只依赖银行；面对亏损和追保要具备心理承受力并坚持不放弃。
